description: This file defines the ConceptInUseException class, a custom exception used within the OpenMRS API to indicate that a concept is currently in use and cannot be modified. It extends APIException and provides multiple constructors for different use cases.

classes.name: ConceptInUseException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a concept is in use, preventing modifications such as datatype changes. Extends APIException and provides multiple constructors for flexibility.

methods.name: ConceptInUseException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating that concepts already in use cannot be modified.

methods.name: ConceptInUseException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message explaining why the concept is locked.

methods.name: ConceptInUseException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message and a cause, facilitating exception chaining.

methods.name: ConceptInUseException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a cause, used for chaining exceptions.
